Mahindra debuted the Scorpio Lifestyler pickup truck on August 14, 2026. The lifestyle pickup truck is based on the same platform as the Scorpio N SUV; however, it has a relatively longer wheelbase to accommodate the load bed.
Under the hood, the Scorpio Lifestyler gets a 2.2-litre diesel engine, which can be mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic gearbox. A four-wheel-drive (4WD) option is available too.
Save for the Isuzu V-Cross and Toyota Hilux, not many pickup trucks are currently available in the domestic market. Upon launch, the Mahindra Scorpio Lifestyler will serve as a more affordable alternative to the aforementioned Isuzu and Toyota offerings.
Mahindra Scorpio Lifestyler Key Highlights:
The Mahindra Scorpio Lifestyler is the production version of the 2023 Global Pik Up concept
Mahindra will launch the Scorpio Lifestyler at a price lower than Rs 19.79 lakh
The pickup truck shares its underpinnings with the Scorpio N SUV
Digital appointments include a portrait-style touchscreen and digital driver’s display
Mahindra Scorpio Lifestyler Exterior and Interior Design:
The Mahindra Scorpio Lifestyler's exterior design takes a lot of inspiration from the Scorpio N. It gets slightly revised headlights, a larger and boxier grille with 'Scorpio' written on top, and vertically stacked LED fog lamps. It gets squared-off wheel arches, alloy wheels, roof rails, and side steps on both sides. At the rear, it gets 3-shaped LED taillights, 'Mahindra' embossing on the tailgate and a dual-tone rear bumper. At its debut, it was shown in three avatars: Reef, Valley, and Trail, with different exterior liveries.
The Mahindra Scorpio Lifestyler's interior features a large touchscreen infotainment system, another display for the AC controls, along with physical controls for the same, a chunky 3-spoke steering wheel with a lot of physical controls and slim AC vents. The Mahindra Scorpio Lifestyler is a 5-seater pickup.

Mahindra Scorpio Lifestyler price & variants
The Mahindra Scorpio Lifestyler will be priced below Rs 19.47 lakh (ex-showroom) when it is launched by March 2027. Mahindra is yet to reveal the variant details of the Scorpio N-based pickup truck.
Check out the Mahindra Scorpio Lifestyler images in our detailed gallery, where we have highlighted the design elements in the exterior and interior of the pickup truck. These images show the Mahindra Scorpio N-based pickup's headlights, grille, bumper, alloy wheels, truck bed, taillights and tailgate designs. The images also show the Scorpio Lifestyler's touchscreen infotainment system, the digital AC controls, and the new 3-spoke steering wheel.
While Mahindra has yet to reveal the colour options available with the Scorpio Lifestyler pickup, it has showcased the model in three avatars: Reef Edition, Trail Edition, and Valley Edition, each with a distinct colour option and livery.
The Reef Edition is finished in an 'Aquareef' shade, which Mahindra says "captures the ever-changing shades of the ocean"; the Trail Edition is finished in 'Sahara Beach ', which "takes inspiration from vast sandscapes"; and the Valley Edition is finished in 'Artemis Grey' and "draws inspiration from the rich, layered hues of expansive estates".
